title: [observability] Needs you is right from the owner's judgements, never a clearing: `spawn alert judge` gains `right`, and the north star is right ÷ judged over 7 days with its judged counts, on /api/core-lines
prompt:
Spawn, objective 148 [observability] (after 141): "Needs you is right", the observability line's north star, is collected from the owner's judgements and never from a clearing. `spawn alert judge` gains `right`. Core line 3, scoped with projects-47 on 2026-11-14 (sync/proposal-needs-you-right-rev-b.md, B; answers 1–3).

Where things stand (main ffda22f5 with 141):
- `observability.needs_you_right` is null, "not collected", since A23 (sync/astra/findings.md; owner 11-12). Its former formula, cleared ÷ ended, counted a condition clearing as "right", and a false alert whose condition went away scored right.
- `spawn alert judge <key> false|stale|duplicate` (objective 092) records `alert.judged {key, verdict}` through `spawn_alert_record`. It clears an open alert. There is no verdict for a real need, so nothing can say an alert was right. Live holds 0 judgements.
- The needs (alerts, never notices; Home's Needs you takes only open ones) fired over a day on live: 31. The 240 task and mission notices are news, are never judged, and are not this objective's (the notice fold follows as its own).

Read: crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql (`spawn_alert_record`, the `alert.judged` fold, `spawn_alerts`), crates/spawn-postgres/src/alerts.rs (`alert_judge`, ALERTS), crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts.rs (`VERDICTS`, `judge_arguments`, `alert`, `judged_record`), crates/spawn-cli/src/main.rs (MORE_USAGE), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (`lines_at`, `Figure`, `figure_json`), core_lines/observability.rs, web/src/coreLines.ts.

Required behaviour.
- `spawn alert judge <key> right|false|stale|duplicate`. `right` says the alert was a real need. Like the others it is recorded once (`alert.judged {key, verdict: "right"}`), never on a notice, and refused for a key no alert has or for one judged already. It changes nothing else: an open alert judged right stays open (its condition clears it later, and it keeps its verdict), and a cleared one keeps its clearing. Every other verdict clears an open alert, as today. The alert step reads `right` the same way: the alert stays open in its memory, so it still clears it.
- `/api/alerts`' `outcome` is the verdict when judged (`right` included), else `cleared`, else null.
- A new store read (`PostgresStore::needs_judged(since)`, NEEDS_JUDGED) gives `{fired, judged, right}` over the needs (`not notice`) fired since `since`, through `spawn_alerts_time`.
- `observability.needs_you_right` ("Needs you is right", share) is right ÷ judged over the needs fired in the last 7 days. It has no value while fewer than 5 are judged. The figure says `judged: {fired, judged, unjudged}` beside its value (unjudged = fired − judged); no `judged` when not read. A need nobody judged counts neither way, and a clearing is never evidence. The hourly sample holds the figure as it holds every figure with a value.
- The card (web/src/coreLines.ts) says it after the name: "Needs you is right (5 judged, 1 unjudged of 6)".
- Who judges is unchanged: the lead, and lead-mac by the owner's word.
- Nothing else changes: every other alert rule, figure and range. 092's test-only `needs_you_right` (the old formula, never read live) stays as it is, with its test.
- Docs: docs/storage.md and docs/fleet-architecture.md name `right`.
- Polled read: `/api/core-lines` gains NEEDS_JUDGED, one count over `spawn_alerts` rows fired in 7 days through `spawn_alerts_time` (the table holds every alert since the fleet began; live has hundreds of rows). sync/obj-148/148-timing.sql is the SELECT. projects-47 timed it on live (2026-11-14): 24 h, 29 needs, 0.29–0.49 ms; 168 h, 135 needs, 0.29–0.31 ms. At live's size (1239 rows, 664 kB) the planner takes a seq scan on spawn_alerts over spawn_alerts_time, which is fine. Cost PASS (the lead).

Unit tests:
- spawn-postgres tests/alerts.rs `a_need_judged_right_stays_as_it_was_and_is_counted`: an open need judged right stays open, then clears by its condition keeping the verdict; a cleared one keeps its clearing; once; never a notice; the judged read counts fired, judged and right, notices never, and nothing past its bound; a refold gives the same rows.
- spawn-cli alerts.rs `a_need_judged_right_stays_open_for_the_step`; `the_judge_verb_takes_a_key_and_one_of_three_verdicts` (not renamed) now takes four, with the new usage.
- main.rs `the_usage_names_the_owners_judgement_of_an_alert` (not renamed): the usage names `right|false|stale|duplicate`.
- core_lines/observability.rs `needs_you_is_right_is_the_share_judged_right_of_the_judged`: null under 5, 3/5 = 0.6, 0/5, 5/5, the counts and `judged` said, none when not read.
- web/test/coreLines.test.ts: a judged share says what it is read from after its name.
Each rule removed alone must fail a test or the scenario. No test is renamed or dropped.

Files: crates/spawn-postgres/sql/schema.sql, crates/spawn-postgres/src/alerts.rs, crates/spawn-postgres/tests/alerts.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/main.rs (usage), crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs, core_lines/observability.rs, web/src/coreLines.ts, web/test/coreLines.test.ts, docs/storage.md, docs/fleet-architecture.md, rsi/scenarios/148.sh (new). 141 (landing first) touches core_lines.rs, coreLines.ts and the web test: 148 is written on top of it. No other open objective touches these files.
The throwaway is +660 −52 on ffda22f5 with 141 (7740399): code and doc comments +126 −39 (observability.rs +48, spawn-postgres alerts.rs +25, spawn-cli alerts.rs +17, schema.sql +14, coreLines.ts +13, core_lines.rs +8, main.rs +1); Rust tests +160 −8 and the web test +22; docs +8 −4; 148.sh +344. Within the size guide.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/148.sh. Black box through `spawn alert judge`, `spawn serve`'s GET /api/core-lines and GET /api/alerts, and web/src/coreLines.ts under node. Six needs (memory_low:1–6) and a notice (task_state:7:10) are fired through `spawn_alert_record`, the writer the alert step uses.
(1) `judge memory_low:1 right` is taken. memory_low:1 judged right is still open (`{"state":"open","outcome":"right"}`), and memory_low:3 judged false is cleared.
(2) With 4 judged (right, right, false, stale), and the notice refused a verdict: the north star has no value and says `judged {"fired":6,"judged":4,"unjudged":2}`.
(3) A 5th, right: the north star is 0.6 with `judged {6, 5, 1}`.
(4) The card says "Needs you is right (5 judged, 1 unjudged of 6)".
(5) The 7 days. Two needs, fired 2 days ago and 8 days ago, are seeded as alert.fired records in the control log at those times and folded as the store folds its log (spawn_control_refold), since the writer stamps its own clock. Each is judged false. The north star is 3 / 6 = 0.5 with `judged {"fired":7,"judged":6,"unjudged":1}`: the 2-day need counts, the 8-day one does not.
On the base (ffda22f5 with 141), 148.sh exits 1 with 7 checks failed. The first is "(1) spawn alert judge memory_low:1 right exited 1: spawn: \"right\" is not a verdict (false, stale or duplicate)"; (2) and (3) find no `judged` beside a null north star, and (4) finds no judged words on the card. On the throwaway:
- 148.sh passes twice; 084, 088, 090, 092, 100 and 141 pass (120 is left out: its vite build writes a cache);
- check-clippy, cargo fmt --check, the spawn-cli unit tests (256), spawn-postgres tests/alerts.rs (7), the web tests (node --test test/) and tsc --noEmit pass. The test list gains the 3 new names, and none is missing.
12 mutants, each alone (mut148.py), each built from a fresh tree. R1 (rev-f F1) adds the live window's two:
- live-window-one-day (the live read bounded at 1 day) fails (5) with 0.6, judged {6, 5, 1};
- live-window-ten-days (10 days) fails (5) with 0.43, judged {8, 7, 1}.
The ten of R0; each run is 148.sh, the spawn-cli unit tests and the web tests:
- record-refuses-right (the record's check), verb-refuses-right (the verb) and right-clears (the fold clearing on right) fail (1);
- no-minimum, judged-not-said (no `judged` beside the figure) fail (2) and needs_you_is_right_is_the_share_judged_right_of_the_judged; notices-counted (the read counting notices) fails (2);
- share-of-fired (right ÷ fired) fails (3) and the same unit test; not-collected (the figure not read) fails (3);
- card-no-judged fails (4) and the web test;
- step-clears-right (the alert step clearing an alert judged right) fails a_need_judged_right_stays_open_for_the_step; the scenario does not run the step.

Verified by: the gate runs 148.sh on the candidate. After the landing, the lead reads observability.needs_you_right on /api/core-lines, and again after 5 judgements (`spawn alert judge`), and posts in sync the value and its `judged` counts with the list it was computed from: the needs of the 7 days with each one's verdict, from GET /api/alerts.
